title: Columbia University: Full Steam Ahead!
summary: New York City has long been considered a financial epicenter and is home to the world's largest stock exchange on Wall Street, the NYMEX for commodity trading and a very active over-the-counter bond market. In recent years energy has taken a more central role in world affairs and New York City is once again playing a leading role. The Center for Energy, Marine Transportation and Public Policy at Columbia University (CEMTPP) has fostered the development of a burgeoning community of energy enthusiasts in both industry and academia.

children.title: It Takes Industry Support Too!
children.summary: In addition to the dedicated faculty that teaches the core coursework the curriculum is enhanced with industry executives. It is not surprising to see the head of a transportation group for a large oil company lecturing students about the intricacies of serving the needs of a complex worldwide refining system or the CEO of a large public tanker company sharing his views on the tanker market.
